newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News to fund investment from cash.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News to fund investment from cash.

text.p: Global media group News Corp Ltd chairman Rupert Murdoch said on Tuesday that News Corp now had US$2.5 billion cash in the bank and planned to leave it there.
He also told the annual meeting that in future News Corp would fund future expansion and investment from cash flow.
"We know we have to be not only viable and profitable but we also need to be strong and liquid," Murdoch told the meeting.
He said that News Corp had raised US$1 billion in debt last Friday and that this had put News Corp into a strong cash position.
"We have now US$2.5 billion in the bank and we plan to leave it there," Murdoch said.
